data: point-in-time USD-M USDT perps from data.binance.vision (897 symbols incl. delisted), downloaded 2026-11-11, no cleaning; anomalous bars are reported, not removed
evaluation: R.evaluate_all(mode=validate, start=2020-05-16T08:00Z, holdout_start fixed) -> same 7 honesty checks; plus holdout per-coin contribution and holdout without its top coin (diagnostic only). Each variant evaluated once; no further variants after looking.

C1_pit_default.reason: Universal v0 with UNCHANGED default strategy params on a survivorship-free universe (top-30 by trailing 30d quote volume, causal). universe_size=30 chosen before any run to match the 29-coin static list, not tuned (dev: 20 -> +1173%, 30 -> +2351%, 50 -> +1637%; 30 is the best of the three, which is a reason to distrust it, but it was fixed in advance).

C2_pit_cap10.reason: The verdict failed on Monte Carlo drawdown and the profit is concentrated. A 10% per-coin cap was the only change that improved tail risk in BOTH dev universes (static: MC p95 -63.6 -> -50.9, Sharpe 1.65 -> 1.76; PIT: MC p95 -65.3 -> -59.8, top-3 share 45% -> 39%) at the cost of return (PIT dev +2351% -> +1332%). top-10/15 and min_history 365d were worse on dev in both universes and are not carried forward. Rebalance-hour offsets were NOT selected from (dispersion is noise).
